//: PublicApi__BaseUrl is supplied here rather than in appsettings.Development.json because that file is gitignored, so a value there would work on one machine and fail on every fresh clone. It points at the API's HTTPS profile (Properties/launchSettings.json in RenoTrack.Api). Prerequisite: 'dotnet dev-certs https --trust'. HTTP is deliberately not offered as an escape hatch — the customer's token travels in this request's path, and PublicApiOptions refuses a plaintext origin in every environment.
